description: Turn a list of metric names and source tables into a metrics.yml catalogue with grains and dimensions. When standing up a metrics layer from a list of agreed KPI names. Do not choose this when the metric SQL must be fully implemented and validated. Example requests: Build a metrics catalogue from these KPI names. | Define these metrics against my source tables. | Create a metrics.yml for my KPIs.

accepted_price.description: The quoted amount, echoed exactly; checked against the quote.

authorized_by.description: Identifier of the human or agent authorizing this job.

buyer_token.description: The buyer_token returned with your first purchase. It opens the purchase history for that buyer, including earlier deliverables.

idempotency_key.description: Retry key; the same key returns the same job.

metric_names.description: The customer's metrics.txt, as text. Supported: Plain text. Metric names, one per line. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

source_tables.description: The customer's tables.txt, as text. Supported: Plain text. Source tables, one per line. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

payment_signature.description: x402 payment payload; required for a priced capability (see submit_job).

quote_id.description: The quote_id from POST /v1/jobs; required when priced.

name: submit_kpi_definition_catalogue
title: KPI definition catalogue
